CityScopeAR

Augmented Reality Urban Simulation

Looking through a tablet, a participant can see the CityScope model and the digital information registered to it at the same time. Moving the tablet changes the viewpoint. Several people can examine the same design from different positions around the table.

cityIO connects the tabletop and its clients so that a change to a shared model can reach another device. The recordings below show uses of that underlying platform in Boston, Hamburg and Andorra. The project paper documents the mixed-reality interface, and the archived source repository preserves the implementation.
